paper_id: Zhuang et al. - 2003 - Hybrid Periodical Flooding in Unstructured Peer-to-Peer Networks
title: Hybrid Periodical Flooding in Unstructured Peer-to-Peer Networks
motivation: 盲 flooding 导致大量冗余流量，而统计搜索存在覆盖率不足问题（partial coverage problem）
problem_framing: 如何在降低流量开销的同时保证查询覆盖率，需在效率和 QoS 之间权衡
key_insight: 用周期函数 f(n,TTL) 自适应调节跳数邻居数，并用多度量混合选择邻居以兼顾效率与覆盖率
method_signature: HPF：周期函数控制邻居数量 + 多度量加权选择邻居集合
evaluation_criteria: 网络总流量、平均响应时间、节点覆盖率、查询覆盖率规模
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: DBFS 仅能覆盖约 77% 的节点（partial coverage problem）；单度量选择路径非最优
evidence_for_taste: A larger h means a smaller chance for all reached peers to form a loop
An efficient mechanism should query more peers using less messages
the query will be flooded to the neighbor that has the largest number of files
DBFS can only cover up to 77% peers
thinking_moves: 将现有方法（盲 flooding、DFS、k-walker）统一泛化为 periodical flooding 的特例（C=1）
识别并命名 partial coverage problem，量化展示其严重性
通过反例（图1）说明单度量选择的路径非最优，从而论证多度量必要性
定义综合指标 p = λC·traffic + λR·time，实现流量与时延的可调权衡
